title: Mainz
summary: Mainz, in Rhineland-Palatinate, was the Roman fort-city Mogontiacum, which World History Encyclopedia says officially dates to 12 BCE and eventually became capital of the province Germania Superior. The city page dates the earliest confirmed traces of Jewish life to the 10th century; Jews were expelled in 1438 and again in 1462.

uncertainty.note: Start is 12 BCE (-11), "officially" per WHE; Romans were in the area as early as 57 BCE per the same page and Drusus is only "said to have" founded it. End is the present.
